goal:
T60 — equal-tools comparison in evolution runs (v3.8 §4.1 "same tool access"; answers the obvious judge question:
does EvoForge win only because the single AI's diffs are applied strictly?).
In services/api/evoforge/evolution_rounds.py + services/api/main.py:
- POST /v1/evolution/runs accepts single_apply: "strict" | "tolerant" (default "strict", so recorded runs stay
  comparable; anything else -> 422). "tolerant" applies the single lane's ONE diff with recount=True (harness
  api-sealed-eval/2) exactly like the EvoForge lane; it is still one Builder call with no Critic and no retry.
- Manifest: lanes.single gets {harness: "api-sealed-eval/1"|"api-sealed-eval/2", apply: "strict"|"tolerant"}, lanes.evoforge
  gets apply: "tolerant"; add manifest.single_apply and manifest.comparison = "equal_tools" when tolerant else
  "chat_vs_system". Update the disclosure sentence to say which applies. Store single_apply on the run document.
- GET /v1/evolution/stats also accepts single_apply=strict|tolerant (filter; other values 422) so the two experiments
  are never mixed in one interval. Runs without the field count as "strict".
- Nothing else changes (scoring, statuses, previews, critic logic).
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t60.py.
